originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&pid_output` is never used.

presenceCondition: (and (= MARLIN_H true) (= PIDTEMP true) (= PID_DEBUG true))
model:
(define-fun PID_DEBUG () Bool
  true)
(define-fun MARLIN_H () Bool
  true)
(define-fun PIDTEMP () Bool
  true)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_54/89 (8c4377dd635.c), dead store on 'pid_output' when MARLIN_H=true, PIDTEMP=true, PID_DEBUG=true. When MARLIN_H=true, the '#ifndef MARLIN_H' block is not compiled (SERIAL_ECHO_START macro and echomagic are not defined). pid_output is initialized to 1 but never subsequently used. In the real Marlin manage_heater() code, pid_output drives heating elements. Simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug (WrongFunArgNum: SERIAL_ECHO_START called with extra argument) requires MARLIN_H=false (for SERIAL_ECHO_START to be defined) — this configuration negates that.
